What's the right technique to strangle my irritating garden weeds without damaging nearby plants?  
To strangle weeds without harming nearby plants, use a hand trowel or weeding tool to carefully dig out weeds, ensuring you remove the entire root system. For larger weeds, apply a vinegar-based herbicide directly to the leaves, avoiding overspray. Mulching with organic material can also suppress weeds by blocking sunlight. Always work carefully to avoid uprooting desirable plants.
